The '''''Mephitis''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was stationed near [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polic Massa]] where it served as home to the [[481st Experimental Starfighter Testing Squadron]] during testing of the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]], an Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] fitted with an experimental [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. For its defense while the TIE phantoms were out on operations, the ''Mephitis'' carried a mixed squadron of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] from the [[29th Fast Attack Squadron]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] from the [[92nd Interceptor Squadron]].
